caption: The drawing depicts a woman with light brown, wavy hair styled in curls and pinned up, wearing a long, elaborate dress. The dress has a light green base with an all-over floral print in colors such as red, pink, white, purple, and blue. The gown features large, ruffled sleeves with cream-colored lace trim. The front panel and inner layers of the skirt are cream or pale peach, edged with additional lace. The dress has a fitted bodice and a wide, flowing skirt that flares out. The background is mostly blank with a pale beige hue, except for the upper right corner, which shows a sample of the same floral pattern as the dress on a green background, also featuring clusters of colorful flowers. The artist's signature, "Lillian Causey," is in the lower right corner.
title: Lady's Costume
